messages:
lucy: FYI canary run (9k RPS) showed unexpected host ingress p99 spike. attaching brief flame. :thinking:
tao: did we change gateway flush or host-proxy recently?
meera: we shipped short-session bias in the batcher last week (prefer smaller batch windows). could interact with flush.
lucy: pprof top: 34% host_proxy::emit_small_frames, 18% grpc::flush_stream, 12% tokenizer::parse, 9% kvcache::evict_path, 6% socket::writev
bud: emit_small_frames that high means many syscalls. gateway was in low-latency mode (flush_interval=2ms) for this test.
meera: combination hypothesis: aggressive gateway flush + batcher favoring small groups -> many tiny writes => writev/flush overhead + kernel selector flips to scalar kernels.
tao: scalar kernels are ~25-40% worse on vectorized HW for medium sequences. if more requests hit scalar path CPU per token goes up.
lucy: plan: matrix run with gateway.flush={2ms,8ms}, batch_hint={small,default}, host-proxy.coalescer={off,4ms}. infra-bot: kicking perf matrix #175472.
infra-bot: perf-job #175472 started. artifacts will be posted to https://ci.internal/perf/175472
meera: also add kvcache.group_by_session=true to test if prefix grouping reduces evictions.
bud: quick mitigation on canary: enabled host-proxy coalescer=4ms and pinned kernel_selector.threshold=28 to prefer vector kernels.
lucy: results: tail down ~33%, host_proxy emit_small_frames samples down ~3.5x, kvcache hitrate improved from 71%->88%.
tao: good. follow-ups: RFC to make kernel selector batch-aware, add adaptive gateway flush based on request size distribution, and make kvcache grouping sticky to session ids.
meera: I'll draft RFC and link perf artifacts. thanks. :thumbsup:
notes: short thread: repro matrix, canary mitigation (coalescer+kernel pin) improved tail and kvcache; follow-up RFC planned
